messages:
Sarah Nguyen: Quick follow-up from the cache-storm postmortem — we need owners, Jira links, and clear handoffs so these don't recur. Who's taking which remediation?
Maya Patel: I can own the eviction alert tuning (root cause: bursty prefix invalidations). Created PM-5123: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PM-5123. ETA end of week. @Janet Li FYI for compliance logging. :white_check_mark:
Liam O'Connor: I'm on the KV-cache short-circuit fallback. Opened INFRA-289 and added initial runbook steps. Will push a canary change Tue.
Devon Chen: I'll handle the rollout policy RACI doc and coordinate with Product for canary thresholds. Draft in Confluence: /spaces/PM/pages/Remediation-RACI. Planning sync Thu 10am.
Sarah Nguyen: Good — can we put a hard owner and an assignee that will be accountable until the Jira is closed? We need single-threaded follow-up.
Maya Patel: Assigned PM-5123 to me. Adding @Liam O'Connor as stakeholder for overlap.
Alex Romero: Noted recurring pattern: we see similar eviction spikes every ~3 weeks during batch jobs. Suggest adding a scheduled pre-warm job and a dashboard alarm. I'll prototype the pre-warm script and add a ticket TEST-74.
postmortem-bot: Action item created: PM-5123 assigned to Maya Patel, due 2026-04-10. Reminder set for 2026-04-08.
Janet Li: From compliance: please ensure audit events for eviction decisions are retained for 90d. Add to the Jira acceptance criteria.
Liam O'Connor: Added compliance AC to INFRA-289. Also putting a regression test in our nightly harness.
Devon Chen: RACI snippet I'm proposing:
```
Responsible: Maya (alert tuning), Alex (pre-warm), Liam (fallback + tests)
Accountable: Sarah (postmortem owner)
Consulted: Product, SRE on rollout windows
Informed: Support, CS
```
Is that ok?
Sarah Nguyen: Yes. Please paste that RACI into each Jira comment and the Confluence remediation tracker.
Maya Patel: Quick handoff note — if I'm OOO next week, @Alex Romero will be the interim owner. I'll update PM-5123 assignee fallback.
Alex Romero: Got it. I'll triage any build failures.
Devon Chen: Also, recurring incident tracking: I've added a field in the remediation tracker sheet for "recurrence cadence" and a flag to escalate to infra-eng if cadence < 30 days. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/remediation-tracker
Sarah Nguyen: Can everyone update their Jira tickets with estimated timelines and link to the regression tests by EOD Wednesday? I'll run a follow-up thread on Friday to confirm closeouts.
Maya Patel: Done for PM-5123 (ETA 2026-04-10).
Liam O'Connor: INFRA-289 updated with test PR link and ETA 2026-04-12.
Alex Romero: TEST-74 created and prototype pushed to branch prewarm/alpha.
Janet Li: Compliance notes added to all three tickets. Leaving a checklist in each ticket for audit.
Sarah Nguyen: Thanks all — putting this on the weekly remediation tracker agenda. If anything blocks, @Sarah Nguyen callout or drop in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
